description: Source code for Stock Reconciliation in ERPNext, including classes, methods, and functions for managing stock adjustments, validation, ledger entries, serial and batch handling, and related operations.

classes.name: OpeningEntryAccountError
classes.description: Validation error for incorrect opening entry account

classes.name: EmptyStockReconciliationItemsError
classes.description: Validation error for empty or invalid stock reconciliation items

classes.name: StockReconciliation
classes.description: Main class handling stock reconciliation operations, validation, ledger entries, serial/batch management, and submission/cancellation workflows

methods.name: get_items
methods.description: Fetches stock items for a given warehouse, date, and company, optionally filtered by item code

methods.name: get_items_for_stock_reco
methods.description: Retrieves items within a warehouse's stock range for stock reconciliation

methods.name: get_item_data
methods.description: Constructs item data dictionary for stock operations

methods.name: get_itemwise_batch
methods.description: Retrieves batch-wise stock data for a warehouse and date

methods.name: get_stock_balance_for
methods.description: Returns stock quantity, rate, and serial numbers for an item in a warehouse

methods.name: get_difference_account
methods.description: Determines the account to use for stock difference based on purpose and company
